name: Clipboard
description: Access the system clipboard for copy and paste operations.

conditions.description: Triggered when a copy to the clipboard is successful.
Triggered when a copy to the clipboard fails.
Triggered on a successful paste of text.
Triggered on a successful paste of binary data.

receive-to.name: Binary data
receive-to.desc: Choose a Binary Data object to write the pasted binary data to.

type.name: Type
type.desc: The content type (aka MIME type) of the pasted data.

actions.description: Copy some text to the clipboard. Note this is usually only allowed in a user input trigger.

text.name: Text
text.desc: The text to copy to the clipboard.

actions.description: Copy some binary data to the clipboard. Note this is usually only allowed in a user input trigger.

data.name: Binary data
data.desc: A Binary Data object to copy to the clipboard.

type.name: Type
type.desc: The content type (aka MIME type) of the data being copied.

actions.description: Request to read text from the clipboard. Note this is usually only allowed in a user input trigger and may show a permission prompt.
Request to read binary data from the clipboard. Note this is usually only allowed in a user input trigger and may show a permission prompt.

expressions.description: In 'On paste text', the text that was read from the clipboard.
